themes.description: Concerns related to the platform's trustworthiness, data security, ethical practices, or potential fraud.
Feedback on the application's user interface, user experience, design, layout, and the availability or quality of specific features.
Issues or feedback related to referral programs, promotional offers, and the receipt or non-receipt of associated rewards.
Requests or feedback related to specific functionalities, display, or usability of the application's features.
Concerns about data security, privacy breaches, unauthorized access, or information leakage.
Covers requests or feedback related to app interface, themes, layout, and personalization options.
This theme covers requests for new features, missing product offerings, or enhancements to existing functionalities.
This theme covers problems with incorrect or misleading display of financial data, portfolio values, or other critical information within the application.
This theme covers reviews that accuse the company or platform of fraudulent activities, misrepresentation, or intentionally causing financial losses.
Covers suggestions and feedback related to the application's user interface, design, and ease of use.
Covers feedback and concerns related to new market regulations, policy changes, and their impact on trading or user experience.
Concerns related to the application's consumption of device resources, such as storage space or battery life, especially after updates.
Feedback regarding the presence, removal, or availability of specific features within the application, especially after updates.
Requests for new functionalities, tools, or data to be added to the platform.
Feedback or complaints regarding existing features, design, or recent updates to the platform.
Requests for new features, functionalities, or enhancements to existing product capabilities.
General complaints about the overall quality, usability, or reliability of the trading platform or website.
Covers user experiences related to market movements, stop-loss triggers, and general trading outcomes that are not directly related to app functionality or financial issues.
Addresses feedback on specific trading features, their usability, changes, or requests for new functionalities within the platform.
Covers feedback related to the app's design, navigation, workflow, and overall ease of use, including issues with feature accessibility and intuitive interaction.
Addresses issues related to the fundamental operation, design, data reliability, and performance of the application, including usability and feature completeness.
Covers general positive feedback, satisfaction with the application's usability, features, and overall service quality.
Issues related to the display, tracking, or management of investments (e.g., fixed deposits, stocks, mutual funds) within the app, including missing or incorrect investment data.
Reviews expressing general satisfaction, positive experiences, or compliments about the platform.
Issues related to account access, login processes, verification steps, and general account settings.
Issues related to login, account verification, security features, or general access to the user account.
Concerns about personal data protection, privacy breaches, unauthorized sharing of information, and spam.
Issues related to incorrect, outdated, or delayed display of financial data, prices, or portfolio information.
This theme covers issues related to account security, potential fraud, unauthorized transactions, or general trust and safety concerns with the application.
This theme covers complaints about unsolicited calls, messages, or emails, often related to new product introductions or marketing.
This theme covers requests for new features, data, or functionalities that are currently absent from the application.
This theme covers issues related to the user interface, readability, presentation, or general ease of use of the application or its generated documents.
Issues related to app layout, menu structure, feature discoverability, and ease of navigation within the application.
This theme captures user requests for new features, enhancements to existing functionalities, or improvements in user experience.
This theme covers feedback related to the frequency, necessity, or impact of application updates.
